title: 健康与生活方式精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我不是每天都跑步，但会尽量在午饭后散步。
items.en: I don't run every day, but I try to take a walk after lunch.
answers: I don't run every day, but I try to take a walk after lunch.
I do not run every day, but I try to take a walk after lunch.
items.notes: not every day 表示并非每天；take a walk 表示散步。

items.zh: 自从减少晚上的咖啡摄入，我就更容易入睡了。
items.en: Since cutting down on coffee in the evening, I've found it easier to fall asleep.
answers: Since cutting down on coffee in the evening, I've found it easier to fall asleep.
Since cutting down on coffee in the evening, I have found it easier to fall asleep.
items.notes: cut down on 表示减少；个人经历的先后关系不等于普遍疗效。

items.zh: 如果连续坐了很久，我会起来活动几分钟。
items.en: If I've been sitting for a long time, I get up and move around for a few minutes.
answers: If I've been sitting for a long time, I get up and move around for a few minutes.
If I have been sitting for a long time, I get up and move around for a few minutes.
items.notes: 现在完成进行时强调持续坐着；主句一般现在时描述习惯。

items.zh: 虽然我很忙，但午餐通常会留出一段不看手机的时间。
items.en: Although I'm busy, I usually set aside some phone-free time at lunch.
answers: Although I'm busy, I usually set aside some phone-free time at lunch.
Although I am busy, I usually set aside some phone-free time at lunch.
items.notes: set aside time 表示专门留出时间；phone-free 表示不使用手机的。

items.zh: 与其周末补很多觉，我想试着每天在相近的时间起床。
items.en: Rather than catch up on sleep at the weekend, I'd like to try getting up at a similar time each day.
answers: Rather than catch up on sleep at the weekend, I'd like to try getting up at a similar time each day.
items.notes: catch up on sleep 表示补觉；try doing 表示尝试一种方法。

items.zh: 让我难以坚持锻炼的，是去健身房需要花很长时间。
items.en: What makes it hard for me to exercise regularly is the long journey to the gym.
answers: What makes it hard for me to exercise regularly is the long journey to the gym.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；make it hard for sb to do 中 it 为形式宾语。

items.zh: 这道菜里的盐比我预想的多。
items.en: This dish contains more salt than I expected.
answers: This dish contains more salt than I expected.
items.notes: salt 不可数；more ... than ... 比较实际与预期。

items.zh: 你想走楼梯，还是等电梯？
items.en: Would you rather take the stairs or wait for the lift?
answers: Would you rather take the stairs or wait for the lift?
Would you rather take the stairs or wait for the elevator?
items.notes: would rather 后用动词原形；take the stairs 表示走楼梯。

items.zh: 为了更清楚地了解作息，我开始记录每天睡觉和起床的时间。
items.en: To understand my sleep routine better, I've started recording when I go to bed and when I get up.
answers: To understand my sleep routine better, I've started recording when I go to bed and when I get up.
To understand my sleep routine better, I have started recording when I go to bed and when I get up.
items.notes: start doing；两个 when 从句并列作 recording 的宾语。

items.zh: 工作到很晚之后，我需要一点时间让自己放松下来。
items.en: After working late, I need some time to unwind.
answers: After working late, I need some time to unwind.
items.notes: unwind 表示放松；after working 的逻辑主语是 I。

items.zh: 即使天气不好，我们也可以在室内做些轻松的活动。
items.en: Even if the weather is bad, we can do some gentle exercise indoors.
answers: Even if the weather is bad, we can do some gentle exercise indoors.
items.notes: even if 引出假设性让步；exercise 指运动时通常不可数。

items.zh: 这周我给自己定的目标是做三次饭，而不是每晚点外卖。
items.en: My goal this week is to cook three times instead of ordering takeaway every evening.
answers: My goal this week is to cook three times instead of ordering takeaway every evening.
items.notes: to cook 作表语；instead of 后接 doing，具体目标比笼统计划更清楚。

items.zh: 我发现睡前看工作邮件会让我更难放松。
items.en: I find it harder to relax when I read work emails before bed.
answers: I find it harder to relax when I read work emails before bed.
items.notes: find it + 形容词 + to do。

items.zh: 午休时我会离开办公桌，到外面透透气。
items.en: During lunch breaks, I leave my desk to get some fresh air.
answers: During lunch breaks, I leave my desk to get some fresh air.
items.notes: get some fresh air：出去透气。

items.zh: 这周我走路的次数比上周多。
items.en: I have walked more often this week than last week.
answers: I have walked more often this week than last week.
items.notes: more often：更频繁。

items.zh: 我想选择一种自己愿意长期坚持的运动。
items.en: I want an activity that I will enjoy sticking with over time.
answers: I want an activity that I will enjoy sticking with over time.
I want an activity that I'll enjoy sticking with over time.
items.notes: stick with：坚持做。

items.zh: 如果今天精力不足，我就把计划调整得轻松一些。
items.en: If I have little energy today, I will make the plan less demanding.
answers: If I have little energy today, I will make the plan less demanding.
If I have little energy today, I'll make the plan less demanding.
items.notes: less demanding：要求较低、更轻松。

items.zh: 我会提前准备午饭，这样忙的时候也不用匆忙决定吃什么。
items.en: I prepare lunch in advance so that I do not have to choose in a hurry when I am busy.
answers: I prepare lunch in advance so that I do not have to choose in a hurry when I am busy.
I prepare lunch in advance so that I don't have to choose in a hurry when I'm busy.
items.notes: in a hurry：匆忙地。

items.zh: 这份包装里的食物有几人份？
items.en: How many servings are in this package?
answers: How many servings are in this package?
items.notes: serving：一份食物。

items.zh: 我只想少放一点糖，不是完全不放。
items.en: I would like less sugar, not none at all.
answers: I would like less sugar, not none at all.
I'd like less sugar, not none at all.
items.notes: less 与 none 区分减少和完全没有。

items.zh: 运动课结束后，我会留一点时间休息再赶下一场安排。
items.en: After the exercise class, I leave time to rest before my next commitment.
answers: After the exercise class, I leave time to rest before my next commitment.
items.notes: commitment：已安排的事务。

items.zh: 我不喜欢拥挤的健身房，因此通常选择安静的时段。
items.en: I dislike crowded gyms, so I usually choose quieter times.
answers: I dislike crowded gyms, so I usually choose quieter times.
items.notes: quieter 为比较级。

items.zh: 这双鞋长时间走路时会磨脚。
items.en: These shoes rub my feet when I walk for a long time.
answers: These shoes rub my feet when I walk for a long time.
items.notes: rub：摩擦，使不舒服。

items.zh: 我需要把屏幕放高一些，才能坐得更舒服。
items.en: I need to raise the screen so that I can sit more comfortably.
answers: I need to raise the screen so that I can sit more comfortably.
items.notes: raise 是及物动词。

items.zh: 我已经很久没有真正休过一天假了。
items.en: I have not had a proper day off for a long time.
answers: I have not had a proper day off for a long time.
I've not had a proper day off for a long time.
items.notes: a day off：休息日。

items.zh: 有时我把口渴误以为只是想喝点有味道的饮料。
items.en: Sometimes I mistake thirst for a craving for a flavoured drink.
answers: Sometimes I mistake thirst for a craving for a flavoured drink.
items.notes: mistake A for B：把 A 误认为 B。

items.zh: 散步对我来说也是整理思绪的时间。
items.en: Walking also gives me time to sort out my thoughts.
answers: Walking also gives me time to sort out my thoughts.
items.notes: sort out thoughts：理清思绪。

items.zh: 虽然我没有完成全部计划，但我保留了每天活动的习惯。
items.en: Although I did not complete the whole plan, I kept the habit of being active each day.
answers: Although I did not complete the whole plan, I kept the habit of being active each day.
Although I didn't complete the whole plan, I kept the habit of being active each day.
items.notes: keep the habit of doing。

items.zh: 我们能选一家也提供蔬菜主菜的餐厅吗？
items.en: Can we choose a restaurant that offers vegetable-based main dishes too?
answers: Can we choose a restaurant that offers vegetable-based main dishes too?
items.notes: main dish：主菜。

items.zh: 我会把工作通知关掉一小时，专心休息。
items.en: I turn work notifications off for an hour to focus on resting.
answers: I turn work notifications off for an hour to focus on resting.
items.notes: focus on 后接动名词。

items.zh: 如果一个目标太难坚持，我会先缩小它的范围。
items.en: If a goal is too difficult to maintain, I start by making it smaller.
answers: If a goal is too difficult to maintain, I start by making it smaller.
items.notes: start by doing：先从某行动开始。

items.zh: 周末的户外活动让我有机会暂时离开屏幕。
items.en: Outdoor activities at the weekend give me a chance to step away from screens.
answers: Outdoor activities at the weekend give me a chance to step away from screens.
items.notes: step away from：暂时远离。

items.zh: 我想了解自己的日常节奏，而不是每天和别人比较。
items.en: I want to understand my own routine rather than compare myself with others every day.
answers: I want to understand my own routine rather than compare myself with others every day.
items.notes: compare oneself with：与别人比较。

items.zh: 预约了固定的运动时间后，我就不那么容易临时放弃。
items.en: Having a fixed time for exercise makes me less likely to cancel at the last minute.
answers: Having a fixed time for exercise makes me less likely to cancel at the last minute.
items.notes: at the last minute：最后一刻。

items.zh: 今天走的路线有很多台阶，比我想象的费力。
items.en: Today's route had many steps and was more tiring than I expected.
answers: Today's route had many steps and was more tiring than I expected.
items.notes: tiring 描述使人疲累的事物。

items.zh: 睡眠记录里有几天缺失，我不想据此就下结论。
items.en: Several days are missing from my sleep record, so I do not want to draw conclusions from it yet.
answers: Several days are missing from my sleep record, so I do not want to draw conclusions from it yet.
Several days are missing from my sleep record, so I don't want to draw conclusions from it yet.
items.notes: draw conclusions：得出结论。
